title: Rav Mari bar Hama

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Arakhin 21a](https://www.sefaria.org/Arakhin.21a.4), where he put a question to Rav Chisda. Hyman suggests that perhaps בר״ח was originally written, meaning “son of Rav Hisda,” and from this “bar Hama” came to be.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Gemara has Rav Mari bar Hama asking Rav Chisda which sage’s view the baraita follows. Another version has Rav Pappa ask Abaye.
Hyman proposes that בר״ח meant “son of Rav Chisda” and was later read as “bar Hama.” The linked passage gives bar Hama and does not tell how that reading originated.
